description: After explicit permission, save transferable image bytes as a private Visual reference on an existing event, Inventory item or contact. Never a real photograph, cover, avatar or evidence. Preserves existing photos. Find entity_id with find_image_target. No bytes means failure; attached=true requires stored-byte and same-record readback. Retry the SAME request_id. ($0.15; API key required)

confirmed.description: true only after the user requested saving this image to this meal.

entity_id.description: Existing entity_id from find_image_target or its create receipt. Never create a duplicate for an image.

entity_type.description: Type of the record the id refers to, e.g. event.

generated_at.description: ISO time if known; do not invent.

generator.description: Generator if known; do not invent.

image.description: ChatGPT chat attachment. Prefer this for images from the conversation; API clients may still use image_base64 or url.

download_url.description: Temporary HTTPS URL ChatGPT provides for this file.

file_id.description: ChatGPT file id (not a Dayze asset_id).

image_base64.description: Actual image bytes, for clients without the ChatGPT file bridge.

mime_type.description: MIME type of the image, e.g. image/png.

request_id.description: Client idempotency key; a retry with the same key returns the original result, e.g. req_2026-10-17_001.

source.description: chatgpt_generated or illustration; illustration stores as external_illustration.

url.description: HTTPS image URL for expert API clients only; SSRF checks apply.
